notes.title: Update Release Date and some Previews
notes.content:
It has now been 5 weeks since the last update. For some, this is a very long time, as we usually release an update almost every Friday, but we are currently working on a somewhat larger update and therefore it is taking longer.

In this post we want to give you some more information about the update, announce the planned date of the update and show you some preview images.

Feedback from the community is very important to us and this is also the reason for this update.
Unfortunately, there is still some help missing in many parts of the game, more tutorials and many more hints to guide you as a player through the game mechanics. In addition, the entire interface in the game has been revised to bring a breath of fresh air into the game with a new design.

All the preview images we are showing now show before and after, but the content in the images may still change before the update.

It starts with the main menu, which has been redesigned and now has some life in the background.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35032966/07e4a8c330aac467c39d95d09b8a7ae976e7bb8a.png[/img]

Especially when you wanted to edit your character, this was not always very nice to look at.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35032966/88771a7f54921c52b11672b9af45ff7271eb1335.png[/img]

All other interfaces in the main menu have also been revised. And the pause menu is also like the main menu in terms of the overview, not like before.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35032966/db256e19dbe6899aafe3667e2dbdd5a9a2538be7.png[/img]

The help at the edge of the screen will be much more detailed in future. It will also be possible for the player to hide the help or collapse individual areas.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35032966/24e42bc9fa78e1813a69844ae2d15421d724918c.png[/img]

In addition, the windows in the game have also been revised, here you can see an example.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35032966/810a0a3b92af4d6958f0da42d0d77c1d06d7fa3a.png[/img]

We could show you a lot more of the various changes to the design, but we don't want to spoil everything. What is important for you now, when exactly will I get this.

The planned date of the upcoming update is 19.09.2025.

We are already looking forward to your feedback as soon as you have the update in your hands.

Otherwise, we wish you a quiet and relaxing weekend.

notes.title: Version 0.6442 Alpha
notes.content:
Greetings gold seekers,

We have great news for you. The Consume and Connect update is here!

With this update you can expect some new challenges to run your facilities, vehicles and furnaces. In addition to fuel, water and gas, you will now also need electricity to continue your gold prospecting activities.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35032966/a265880053a4c1e5bb4959c9396225c48be4dbed.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35032966/49a051ededd05a49fad95523deefd6e8315511c5.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35032966/074a7f14ad77954a66b75e031eae5179ae2d4b3e.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35032966/8177e6ddb623e236ce75d64a0a68b0bd551872ff.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35032966/177f7edf604cb93b71e0dc039f7c0821c10f3de1.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35032966/1379a556ff7c95eed62cb463c39a329ccea04966.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35032966/1b6ad402d807e47f06ad596e78b23cb312332f8c.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35032966/eebcbd5cf8f705df1ae4e54327dc7de7ac47be00.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35032966/cbf86a2d8cfc0e245442bceed44fbc05bb8499ac.jpg[/img]

Have you run out of fuel on your machines? No problem.
A suitable trailer is now available from the vehicle dealer.
For a small fee, you can call it your own.
Why don't you drop by with your pickup?
Provided your pickup has a trailer coupling.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35032966/e41f0fb3cc1e24e8edafe8f042492d3ad363b362.jpg[/img]

And while you're in town, why not pop into one of the petrol stations? We've heard that the renovation work has been completed and they're now open again. They might even sell you a suitable canister or gas bottle.  Because you never know what you might need it for.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35032966/f6260d233b3cc26125e5363c1eb9c58f3de9be47.jpg[/img]

Is fuel too expensive for you? Then we have a little tip for you.
Just keep an eye on the little sign on the petrol pump.
You never know what time will bring.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35032966/0f5e301974535709c93334e88a5ea822feafe25d.jpg[/img]

Now let's go, time is gold! You still need some equipment. So off to the store.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35032966/54baaae870c092ced223938382a3e9d7be48dc2b.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35032966/c6603eb8ca819944ec82fa688338adce319ac225.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Update Consume & Connect
notes.content:
Soon the time will come. After a long time, fuel, electricity, water and gas consumption will finally come into play. But you'll have to be patient for a few more days.

Consumption will change a lot of things in the game. You can no longer simply start the engine or the machines, so you can, but it will cost you money.

In addition, some other features have been revised, such as the Physic Watch, which is responsible for turning the physics of items and vehicles on or off as required.

It has happened from time to time that items or vehicles have disappeared, but this should no longer happen with the revised version.

Of course, various bugs will also be fixed and perhaps there will be a surprise or two. 

The “Consume & Connect” update is planned for April 2025.

Gold Hunter is currently still on offer for around 24 hours, so grab it now so that you can enjoy the game, the new update and many other updates.

So, that's all for now. Here are some preview images of the update.

notes.title: Happy New Year
notes.content:
The year 2024 is now drawing to a close. We can look back on a successful year.
A lot has happened this year and we would like to summarize it here.

The biggest milestone this year was the switch to Unreal Engine 5, which was finally completed. There were also a total of 33 updates this year, which was an update every 1.5 weeks on average. Since the switch to Unreal Engine 5 is complete, there will not only be updates in the future that contain
mostly bug fixes, but also new features and functions that will be added to the game.

The next major milestone is already being worked on from January, namely the “Consume & Connect” update. Many will already be looking forward to the update and another base will then find its place in the game. This update will then include fuel consumption for vehicles, as well as electricity and water consumption. In addition, gas consumption will be added for melting and much more.

The update is expected to be released at the end of January or beginning of February.

Until the big update, the regular Friday updates will continue, but will be smaller. This will allow us to focus on the big upcoming update and still provide you with small updates.

Well, that's all for now.

The whole Gold Hunter team wishes all players a happy new year.

notes.title: Winter Sale & Free 2 Play Weekend
notes.content:
We have some good news for you.

So far this month we have released many updates and with each update the game is getting better and better. The focus is of course on bug fixing, but we've already added some new features to the game and there are many more features planned.

Here you can find our roadmap: [url=https://trello.com/b/EC8Gd7iP/roadmap-public-early-access]Trello Roadmap[/url]

But now we would also like to give the community a little Christmas treat.
The game can currently be purchased in the Winter Sale with a 20% discount.

We are also offering everyone the opportunity to play the game for free at the weekend.
This will be a kind of “Free 2 Play” weekend, in the form of a demo/playtest.

So everyone can have a look at the game and become a prospector themselves.
At the event, you will be able to test all functions except for the multiplayer. This will not be activated during the Free 2 Play weekend for organizational reasons. In future events the multiplayer will be activated, but we will need more planning and this event was a spontaneous Christmas surprise.

notes.title: New Milestone has arrived
notes.content:
The Unreal Engine 5 version for Gold Hunter is now available for everyone.

But please keep in mind that Gold Hunter is not yet a finished game, it is still in Early Access.

Our game has been 95 percent reprogrammed in Unreal Engine 5, but this will make many things easier in the future. To ensure a clean start, we have decided that everyone will start from scratch.
This avoids old bugs and incorrect items from older savegames.

The experimental version will be switched off and all future updates will be on the standard version.
If we are working on major updates, we will switch to the experimental version if necessary.

If you find a bug or have an idea, you are welcome to report it to us via F8, this helps us a lot.


You can find our future roadmap here: https://trello.com/b/EC8Gd7iP/roadmap-public-early-access


That's it for now, the Gold Hunter team wishes all players a nice weekend.

notes.title: Goodbye UE4, Hello UE5
notes.content:
Goodbye UE4, Hello UE5

After more than a year, the time has finally come and everyone will be playing Gold Hunter on Unreal Engine 5. The players who had activated the experimental version in the meantime were already able to enjoy the Unreal Engine 5 to some extent.

It's been a long road and unfortunately this has also slowed us down, as 95 percent of everything in Unreal Engine 5 has been reprogrammed. However, this was necessary to ensure that the code was clean from the outset. This means that errors can be found more quickly or even avoided directly.
Additional features and functions can also be implemented much more easily as a result.

But we are still a long way from reaching our goal, this is just another step in the right direction.
The game is far from finished and will still take some time.

There will continue to be regular updates, which we usually schedule for Friday. The update can be smaller or or larger. Of course, it can also happen that a new feature takes considerably longer to make it into the update.

Due to the numerous bug reports from the community in the experimental version, we have already been able to find and fix many bugs. The bugs don't simply disappear with a new code and new bugs will of course also appear.

But we are still dependent on you to send us regular bug reports if there are any errors in the game.
Ultimately, this is the only way to make the game a little bit better with every update. Our mods are regularly testing, but this is only a small group and not every bug can be found, but most of them can.

The game world is also new, but there will probably be changes there too, as a new voxel version will be released at the beginning of next year and we really want to use it, as it contains a lot of new features and performance improvements. That's why not so much time is being invested in the current game world. We will keep you up to date on this.

Now we come to the date. Herewith we set December 6, 2024, where the same version will be available for everyone. Unfortunately, an exact time is not yet known, but just keep an eye on the social networks. Unfortunately, this also means that players who have not yet started the experimental version will have to start a new savegame. This is because the savegame files are unfortunately not compatible. We always try to avoid this, but disappointingly it doesn't always work.

As mentioned above, you can look forward to regular updates, including bug fixes, new features and much more.

You can find an overview on our roadmap: https://trello.com/b/EC8Gd7iP/roadmap-public-early-access



Otherwise, the Gold Hunter team wishes you a great start to the new week.

notes.title: Version 0.64 *Experimental*
notes.content:
Version 0.64 Alpha has been released on the Experimental Branch.

The most important change is the switch from Unreal Engine 4 to Unreal Engine 5.
Everyone must start a new savegame and please note that this is an experimental version.

So that you don't have to wait any longer, we'll let you be part of it.

You can switch to the "Experimental" beta in Steam as follows.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35032966/4fb10cc66ce5713fee774d2968755e2363d10896.png[/img]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35032966/5fec2fee37ff7ff0d209956571c458319aa6af8e.png[/img]

Please note, if you have played Gold Hunter before, to deactivate the Steam Cloud for Gold Hunter once and delete all savegames locally.

Here is the path to the savegames, simply enter it in the browser line of your desktop.

[i]%userprofile%\AppData\Local\GoldHunter\Saved\SaveGames[/i]

Please note that many things are still deactivated or unfinished.
These will be added bit by bit with regular updates.

Otherwise we look forward to your bug reports, you can create them directly in the game with "F8".

The team wishes you all a nice weekend and happy holidays.

notes.title: Contest - Your Claim, your Name
notes.content:
Today I am contacting you with a competition. For the next update, 3 claims will already be activated, comprising a total of 35 plots.
That's enough space to start with, compared to the old map, where fewer than 10 claims were active, and one parcel on the new map is as big as an old claim.
However, we would like to give these claims a name and we thought we would leave that up to the community and make a competition out of it.

Everyone can only vote once and each participant must adhere to the following rules.

- no double participation (if we find out, the participant will be excluded)
- the names should be user-friendly and not protected

The competition will run for 14 days and ends on 22.03.2024 at 6 pm german time.
The team will then select the top 10 from all valid entries.
After that, the community will have 7 days to vote for their favorite.
The closing date will be 29.03.2024 at 6 pm german time. The top 3 will then enter the game.

You can submit your suggestion for a claim name in the form below. 

https://forms.gle/sphdWXw3pDgDrZqx7 (Already closed)

Vote Now for your favorite claim name: https://forms.gle/XxbdrMu4jUt4RkDF6


We look forward to a large number of participants and wish all players a great weekend.

notes.title: Dev-Blog #13
notes.content:
Now it's time for the next dev blog. In the last announcement, I was already able to give you a date for the upcoming update. It's only a few weeks away. During this time, the last things for the update will be made available.

This includes the map, some missing functions and various bug fixes.
Thanks to the daily livestreams, you can see the progress at any time and also see exactly what is being added to the game. So that this time can be used as productively as possible, the team has decided that the developer livestreams will be canceled until the update.

On the one hand, this has the advantage that intensive tests can be carried out regularly and agreements can be made directly. It also gives us the opportunity to prepare some surprises for you.
The landscapes on the map in particular are still being designed and players will be presented with a completely new environment for the update.

But there will still be a livestream every Friday evening where we can just chat and maybe show some spoilers. Well, that's all for today. The team wishes everyone a great weekend.

You can always check the current status in the roadmap for Unreal Engine 5.

Link to the UE5 roadmap: https://trello.com/b/k0nYI1tG/roadmap-ue5

notes.content:
Now I'm getting back to you with an announcement that many have been waiting for and now the time has finally come. The wait is over, well not quite yet, you still have to be patient, but today I can give you a date for the upcoming update.

As already mentioned in previous posts, the update will first be released on the experimental version, so everyone can already get access to the update. A few weeks later it will be released on the stable version so that the last bugs can be found.

The big change in this update is the change of the engine, from 4 to Unreal Engine 5.
In this update, the focus is on the basic functions, the multiplayer and the new map.
Further functions and items will be added bit by bit.

The next few months will be actively used to design the levels, fix bugs and implement the final functions.
The new map will only have the base for the time being. Other locations, points of interest and other details will be added in future updates.

And now the most important thing, the date for the update.

[u][b]Update Release 0.6 Alpha Experimental: 3/29 2024 at 8pm.[/b][/u]

notes.content:
The year is almost over and I'll get back to you again.
I hope everyone got through the holidays well.

A long year is behind us and a lot has been achieved this year.
Even if you as a player cannot see the progress directly, as the last update was in the first quarter, a lot has been achieved.

The switch to Unreal Engine started in May and the switch has already been completed in just a few months. This is a great success and the changeover went largely without any problems.

The next livestream will take place again from January 1st, 2024, as there will simply be a break between Christmas and New Year.

All basic functions have already been integrated into the engine and we are in the final phase of extensive testing of all functions.

notes.title: Dev-Blog #10
notes.content:
I'll get back to you with the next dev blog. It's been 3 weeks since the last dev blog and a lot has happened since then. This dev blog is not about the functions and programming this time, but about level design.

The last few weeks the map has been worked on at full speed. And today I want to show you the progress. But before I show you any more details, I'll explain very briefly how this came about.

Since we have already switched to Unreal Engine 5, we also considered how this should be implemented with the map. Due to the switch to the new engine, the old map with the content could unfortunately not be taken over. There were 2 options to consider.

Either you would have taken the old map and filled it with new content, or you would have invested a little more time and created a new map. The decision fell on the new map and that's what today's dev blog is about.

Here are a few details and dates to give you a better idea.
The old map had about 16 square kilometers and up to 12 claims were planned. The largest claim was claim 7 and was about 100x100m in size.

Now the data for the new card. The new map will have approximately 68 square kilometers and 14 claims are already planned, but each claim is still divided into parcels. Each plot is 100x100m and there are already over 600 plots in total. Compared to the old map, it would be over 600 claims. I think you can see a clear difference.

The length of the roads that have already been laid is currently over 25 kilometers and the rivers are over 21 kilometers long. There will also be a port, a train station and many more places. This also includes an old gold mining town.

And another info, the whole map is using voxels, means it would be theoretically possible to dig everywhere and do terraforming.

An important part that plays a big role is the issue of performance.
And I can tell you, the performance is just great. On this large 68 square kilometer map, the performance is significantly better compared to a map of 500 x 500 meters in the same engine. Both cards have the same comparison value, relatively empty condition. The landing time on the new large map is less than 10 seconds.

This was also tested in the team, so here is some information. With a "Geforce 1660 Super" graphics card you can achieve an average FPS of 75 FPS on "High" graphics settings and this graphics card is one of the older models from 2019. This means that you can also play comfortably on older graphics cards.

I think pictures say more than any long text, so here are a few pictures.
All images are a preview of what is to come but is still subject to change. The map is a work in progress and not complete.

The image below shows the size of the card. Below the lake is about the size of the old map.

notes.title: Unreal Engine 5
notes.content:
So fast it can go, I'll get back to you. I hope you had a good start into the new week. In the meantime, half of the week is already over and we'll soon be heading back to the weekend.

This morning we had a livestream, where unexpected problems occurred.
We are currently working with the Unreal Engine 4.26.2 and have been using it for a very long time.
Until now, it was actually clear that there are no more updates coming from the Unreal Engine, because this version is already over 3 years old.

However, a few days ago there was an update that affected our current Unreal Engine version. Since we rely on some plugins, like voxel, vehicle system, etc., they have to be compatible with our version as well. Unfortunately, most plugin creators only support 3 versions. Since there is now the 5.2, we are with our version no longer in the range where we can still expect updates.

In today's livestream it was already stated that at least 2 plugins will no longer receive an update with our version. Unfortunately, this leads to the fact that we have no other option than to get a newer version. This step was actually only in the later development possibly planned, as this also brings a lot of advantages.

We also had a meeting a few minutes ago, in which all possibilities were collected, discussed and we decided to switch.
This means that we will integrate our project on a new Unreal Engine version.
Unfortunately there is no other possibility, we have to make this switch so that the game can get updates in the future. Due to this decision, the already published roadmap from the previous post is invalid.

To avoid such a step in the future, we will build the project on our own source files of the Unreal Engine. This will give us the opportunity to avoid any compatibility issues at any time. This will avoid such errors or problems in the future. And this will allow us to decide for ourselves if and when we want to receive updates provided by the Unreal Engine.

Unfortunately, this is also a very time-consuming step, because we cannot simply copy the project to the new version. We can copy items, objects and vehicles, but all modules and functions have to be rebuilt.

Of course we will take you with us on this way. In the live streams you can see the progress and there are also various pictures and videos posted on all social networks. So we can feed you regularly with information.
Starting tomorrow, we will start directly with Unreal Engine 5.2 in the livestream and make the first preparations for all further steps.

Of course, everyone is interested to know if this will delay the next update and the answer is definitely yes. As mentioned above, unfortunately we have no other way to deliver further updates for the game in the future. Unfortunately, we can't say a time frame, as this can't be estimated yet. But as soon as we can say something more precise, you will be the first to know.

One thing I can tell you already, as soon as the first modules run stable, like character, vehicles, multiplayer and savegame, we will publish this on our experimental version on Steam, so you can get a first impression.

Otherwise, that's it for today, I wish you a pleasant rest of the week and see you in the next livestream.

notes.title: 1st Anniversary Early Access
notes.content:
It has been one year since the release of the Early Access version of Gold Hunter.
A lot of energy and time has been put into the project and we still have a lot planned.
First of all, we would like to thank all players for their support, be it in the form of suggestions, bug reports and livestreams. This is what makes the game unique and
allows us to design the game partly according to the players.

There have been many ups and downs in the past, all of which we have been able to overcome so far.
In the end, that's what makes the project and also makes us strong for future tasks.

[u][b]Live Streams[/b][/u]

Currently I am still a bit sick, but I hope that this will improve in the near future. From the 15th of June I plan to start regular developer livestreams again. That means, again dev streams from monday to friday and there will be as usual on friday evening the talk stream. the talk stream. In the talk stream we talk about news, answer your questions and if an update is planned, the changes will be shown and the update will be released afterwards.

[u][b]Updates[/b][/u]

The next planned update should come this month. Unfortunately I can't give an exact date yet. In this update the focus is on multiplayer, gold balance and general bug fixes. There will be no further system and enhancements yet, because I lost some time due to my illness.

But by popular demand from the community, the Experimental version will be back. For you as a player, this means that we will bring future updates to "Experimental" first and this can be tested extensively. 

Since all players will have access to this version, a large number of players can filter out the last bugs in the shortest possible time and we can fix them.

After 1-2 weeks the version can then come to the "stable", ie standard version of the game. This means that we don't only have a small group of players who can test the update before it is actually released, but every player can test it.

Once the next update is released, there will also be an update every week on Friday if necessary. This is to get back into the rhythm of being able to provide an update within a short period of time.

[u][b]Roadmap 2023[/b][/u]

We still have over 6 months to release various updates this year.
In this time there will also be one or the other new system/module in the game.
To give you a little foretaste, I'll mention a few points here.

■ more vehicles
■ tank system
■ company system (employee-, vehicle- and rights management)
■ power system (generators, cables, etc.)
■ water system (pumps, hoses, etc.).

These are just a few modules that will be waiting for you.

[u][b]Social Networks[/b][/u]

Another point, are the social networks. Unfortunately, these have been used very rarely in the past. On Discord or Steam news and announcements are published, but you can provide much more. Be it regular news, teasers on future updates and much more. 

In addition, other networks such as Youtube, Facebook, Twitter, etc. were very neglected.
But this should change in the future and we want to fill these channels with regular content.

So, that should be it for today's article. We hope that we can answer many of your questions.
If you still have questions, please feel free to ask us.

Otherwise, we wish all players a nice weekend and see you at the next livestream.

notes.title: Dev-Blog #7
notes.content:
Today I'm getting back to you with the next dev blog.

Some time has passed again and I have some news for you.
In the last 2 months a lot of progress could be made again and the big update is getting closer.

Many are already waiting very excitedly for it and here I will also briefly explain what the update will contain everything. The biggest change in the next update will be the Gold Balance. The gold balance will be completely revised.

In addition, the transfer and the animations between the items have been rebuilt, so the performance has also been improved. Furthermore, there will be many improvements in the multiplayer, which will significantly improve the gaming experience with friends.

Of course, we are also working hard to find and fix more bugs and errors.
At this point I would also like to thank all the players who regularly report bugs via the Bug Report System.

This month was also our marathon on Twitch and tremendous progress was also made during this time. This includes, among other things, many improvements in the area of performance, which make it possible to enjoy a smoother gaming experience.

Unfortunately, there was hardly any livestream lately, because the hardware failed on my end. But the problem has been solved in the meantime. During this time off I was able to take care of some important things concerning the company, which were left undone during the marathon. Some people don't know yet that I'm doing this alone by now. Therefore some new tasks have been added.

Starting Monday, there will be regular livestreams on Twitch again, where you can look over my shoulder during development. The dev livestreams are as usual on monday, wednesday and friday. Additionally, there will be a talk stream on Friday at 7pm.

And finally, the most important thing that every player is interested in. When is the update coming?

Due to the hardware problems, the planned update, which was scheduled for the end of April, was delayed.
Therefore, the update is unlikely to be released in April and is expected to be released in May. You can always check with us in Discord about the status of the update.

https://discord.com/invite/goldhunter


Personally, I'm also looking forward to the livestreams on Twitch again.

Here again the link to Twitch. https://www.twitch.tv/goldhuntermp

In this sense I wish all players a nice weekend.

notes.title: Dev-Blog #6
notes.content:
[u][b]Preface[/b][/u]

Well it's that time again, the next dev blog is back. In case you missed some news, the blog is just the right thing for you.
In the last weeks a lot has happened, be it updates, changes or news and about that we want to inform you today.

[u][b]Updates[/b][/u]

At the end of January there was a very big update, which included many changes and bug fixes.
You can read the details in the changelog. https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1082450/view/3346757662563126882

But also this month we released some updates which fixed many more bugs in single- and multiplayer.
Of course, there are still bugs in various places, but they are already on the list and will be the focus of the next updates.

These include the following features or revisions.

■ Performance improvement
■ Re-enable point of sale
■ Rework gold balance
■ Rework gold wash
■ Rework voxel
■ Saving of client data
■ Missing/incorrect synchronization in multiplayer.

So you already have an overview of which tasks and goals are in the foreground for the next updates.

Further updates are also coming regularly, but no exact date can be given.
The release of an update depends on the scope, duration of testing and bug fixing.

[u][b]QOL-Tester[/b][/u]

We recently added a new section ([b]Q[/b]uality [b]o[/b]f [b]L[/b]ife-Testers) to our team.
This area supports the developers, so more intensive and detailed tests are possible.
This has the advantage that in future updates there will be more capacity for internal tests.
Especially when new features or extensive areas are added to the game, the QOL testers can track down bugs even in longer tests.

[u][b]Change of price[/b][/u]

Another change you may have noticed is the price of the game.
After much deliberation, the price has been adjusted, which should please many players who were previously still put off by the high price.
No further price change is planned in Early Access, except for discounts and events.

[u][b]Conclusion[/b][/u]

That should be it for this dev blog for now. We wish you a nice weekend and see you until the next dev blog.

You are welcome to join our Discord, there you will also find regular news, announcements and you can talk with other players.
If you want to look over the shoulder of a developer, we invite you to our regular livestreams on Twitch.

Discord: https://discord.com/invite/goldhunter
Twitch: https://www.twitch.tv/goldhuntermp

notes.title: Dev-Blog #5
notes.content:
Now the year is coming to an end soon and we can look back on a long year full of events.
There were many ups and downs, but in the end we survived this year as well.

Successes included the Early Access release, regular livestreams, and feedback from our community.
Unfortunately, there are also failures, but we can also learn from them and use that positively for further development for us.
These included, for example, delays and also cases of illness, even though you can't always plan for everything.

Even though we unfortunately couldn't put an update under your Christmas tree yet, we can tell you in the meantime when the next update can be expected.
We have made so much progress and achievements regarding the next update in the last 2 weeks that we will be able to provide the update for you in January.

Since many have visiting family, friends and acquaintances over the holidays and New Year, the next livestream on Twitch will be on 2nd of January 2023.

We wish all players a Merry Christmas, relaxing holidays and a Happy New Year.

notes.title: Dev-Blog #4
notes.content:
It's time for another dev blog.

The most important thing right at the beginning: My(cHaOsFaTz) health is fine again. So we can work again at full speed on the planned update.

Of course, there is a lot of work to be done before we can make the update available to you.
But before we go into more detail about the upcoming update, we want to talk about the topic of communication.

[u][b]Communication and tasks[/b][/u]

During my absence we noticed that there was a lack of communication. You had the information that I was ill, but no further details about what that meant for the development.
So no information about what the rest of the team has done or achieved during this time. Before we can go into that, we want to briefly explain to you what the responsibilities in the team are.

We have often received questions such as "What is the rest of the team doing?", "What is the status of the update?", "Why haven't the others continued working on the update?" and a few more questions related to these topics. Therefore, here is a brief list of the distribution of tasks that are directly related to the development of the game.

The development team consists of four people:
- There is me as the project manager and main developer.
- Another developer
- A 3D designer
- A level designer

This should make it clear that everyone has their own special area of responsibility. And if one of them is absent - due to illness or other incidents - then not everyone in the team can take over the tasks of the others, because special knowledge and skills are necessary for each area.

Another important thing that has been said far too seldom, and which we also want to clarify again today, concerns the working time or rather the possibility to work on the project.

All the people involved work on the project out of passion for the idea of the game, and the potential they see in the idea.
However, as the project leader and main developer in the development team, I am the only person who has the opportunity to work on the project full time. The other three team members each have a different main job and then work on the project in their remaining free time.
Perhaps this circumstance was not yet known to one or the other. Maybe this makes it a bit more understandable why the progress in recent times could not be as great due to my absence as it would have been if the whole team had been able to work on the project full time.

[u][b]Where do we go from here and what will change?[/b][/u]

As mentioned above, we are currently working on the next update. Our focus for this update is on the basic functionality and the most serious bugs. All other planned new functions and features will therefore be put on hold for the next update, because for us the most important thing is to clean up the existing content, which still has major errors in some places.
Due to the illness and the resulting delay, there will unfortunately also be no Christmas event in the game this year.

The next update is planned for this winter, but we can't give you an exact date yet, as there are still many open tasks to be completed.
As soon as we have released the next update, we will be able to work on adding more planned functions and features.

[u][b]How is the progress since the last update? [/b][/u]

Since a lot of time has passed since the last update, we want to show you what has been done or completed so far.

The changelog, which is not yet published, refers to the changes to the "stable" version on Steam, and not to the "experimental" version, as this already contains a large part of these updates.
The list is already very long and can already be viewed at: https://pastebin.com/sm28NgVq . However, changes are still possible.

What we want to show with this is that we have not been idle during all this time, but that there has already been a lot of progress.

[u][b]Livestreams[/b][/u]

What might also interest some players is how the livestreams on Twitch will continue. I have also thought about this with the team.
As of now, the plan is as follows: The livestreams will be divided into categories, firstly "developer streams" and secondly "news and talk".
The "developer streams" will probably take place on Monday, Tuesday and Wednesday, but there is no fixed time yet.
The "News and Talk" stream will take place every Friday at 7 pm.
So there should be something for everyone. In addition, the announcements for the livestreams will be communicated on all social networks.

[u][b]Finally[/b][/u]

We hope that we could answer some open questions and improve the communication between players and team in the future.
We wish you a nice rest of the weekend and stay healthy.

notes.title: Dev-Blog #3
notes.content:
Another week has passed and we provide you with the next dev blog.
Since not so much time has passed since the last blog, there are not so many news.

The health condition of me has not improved yet, unfortunately. I will probably be out for a while.
The rest of the team is still working as usual, but can only compensate for my downtime to a limited extent. But as already mentioned, this will of course delay further development until I am feeling better again.

I hope to get better quickly so that I can continue to work on my outstanding tasks for the next update.
We also understand that this will cause a further delay until I am ready to work again.

The date for the planned update we have also imagined differently but health must have priority at this point. Unfortunately we can't give a date yet, but as soon as I'm feeling better, you'll be the first to know.

We will also get through this difficult time in the coming month and not let it get us down.

In this sense we wish you a nice Sunday and a good start into the new week.

notes.title: Dev-Blog #2
notes.content:
It's that time again: it's time for another dev blog.
Some may have wondered at what intervals we bring the dev blogs, so we'd like to explain briefly.
The dev blog is intended to be an information medium in which we inform you as players about news, updates and progress.
Therefore, this blog may appear several times a month, but our aim is for it to appear at least once a month.

What I'm sure everyone wants to know: How is the update progressing and when can you play it - and that is what this blog is about today.
We've been working on the next update for many weeks, testing, fixing and also developing it further, but we also have setbacks and unplanned changes from time to time.
At the moment I have health problems, which is why we have not yet made the progress that we had planned for this period.

The whole team is trying to smooth out this situation and some tasks have therefore been redistributed to compensate for this problem somewhat.
This makes it possible for us to continue to complete the tasks, but not at the same speed as you have been used to.

That's why the last two Friday streams have unfortunately been cancelled.

Of course, this situation is not nice, but as they say, health comes first, because the sooner you feel better, the sooner you can work at full power again.
Currently, progress is not in line with our internally set schedule, but we are still trying to deliver the update in a timely manner.

Unfortunately, this first update will not yet contain everything that we have indicated on our roadmap for the next update. However, we are focusing even more on the most important bug fixes to significantly improve the game experience, especially in multiplayer.
Planned changes, improvements and bug fixes that unfortunately do not yet find a place in the next update due to the situation will be added in a timely manner.

When can you expect the update and what will the next update contain?
As already mentioned above, we are focusing on the most important functions in the game. An important point that has already been implemented in the "Experimental" and is currently still being intensively tested is the synchronisation of voxel editing in multiplayer.
Another function is, for example, the so-called "LoadingBay", with which you as a player can load a vehicle with items and then transport them across the map. This is supposed to be a significant improvement, both in single and multiplayer.
Furthermore, various bug fixes will also be included in this update.

We expect to be able to make the update available to you within the next few weeks.
Whether there will be a Halloween event and an update at the same time, we cannot promise at this point - due to the current situation.
But starting next Friday, we will try to make the livestream available again on a regular basis.

With this in mind, we wish you a nice rest of the weekend and we'll see you in the next dev blog at the latest.

notes.title: Dev-Blog #1
notes.content:
From now on, there will be a Dev-Blog at regular intervals to inform you about current topics.
This will cover progress in development, general news and future updates.

In addition, we will discuss the individual topics in more detail in our weekly livestreams, always on Fridays at 7 pm on Twitch, to which we would like to invite you. 
You are very welcome to ask your questions about the presented things in the stream - but also about other topics that have always interested you.

We are currently working hard on the next update, which will unfortunately take some time.

In order to bridge the time, we recommend that you install the "Experimental" version.
In this version you can already try out some progress and improvements in game mechanics, performance and multiplayer.
Here you will find instructions on how to activate it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35032966/4fb10cc66ce5713fee774d2968755e2363d10896.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35032966/5fec2fee37ff7ff0d209956571c458319aa6af8e.png[/img]

Apart from that, we are making great progress regarding the next update. This will be version 0.63, as the functions, improvements and also bug fixes are already very extensive.

Unfortunately, we can't give you a date for the update today, because we still have to invest some time.
This includes extensive tests, which are very time-consuming, so that everything works well in the end.

So that you know what you can look forward to in the upcoming update, we have summarised a few points for you here.

■ Fixing bugs in single- and multiplayer
■ More items
■ Improvement of the performance
■ Gold balance
■ better movements from the diggers
■ Running when crouched
■ Shopping carts to avoid carrying all items individually
■ Chains (to carry stuff with the excavator)
■ spoil behind the washing facilities
■ Loading system of items revised (so that vehicles no longer go flying)
■ Tank system
■ Marking posts to mark areas
■ Gold and dirt visible in the mats
■ and much more

To keep you up to date, you can check the status for the upcoming update and future content in our roadmap.

https://trello.com/b/EC8Gd7iP/roadmap-public-early-access

Otherwise, have a great weekend and see you on the next Dev-Blog.

notes.title: News September
notes.content:
You are probably already waiting eagerly for the next update. In the livestreams you could see that we are working on it regularly and you could observe the good progress.

This update will be one of the most important updates of this year. That's why we're taking enough time to make sure that it fixes the problems that bother you the most, so that you can have a good gaming experience in both single player and multiplayer.

As you can imagine, the livestreams somewhat limit the possibilities for short-term communication and coordination within the team. In order to be able to focus on the update as best as possible, we will reduce the livestreams to a minimum for the time being. This doesn't mean that we won't be streaming at all, but we will - as in the past - do a Friday stream at 7 pm european time. However, there will be no development in the stream, but it should be a relaxed stream in which progress can be shown and talked about and your questions answered. 

For those who regularly join us in the stream, this may sound negative at first, but the possible intensification of the work on the update, will have a positive effect.

We cannot yet say when the update will be available, as this of course also depends on the intensive internal tests. But we will keep you regularly up to date even without the livestreams. On the one hand via our Discord server, but also via the new Dev-Blogs, which we will publish regularly on Steam and which will also be distributed via the social networks.

notes.title: News
notes.content:
It has been two weeks since the last update and you are probably wondering what has happened in the meantime.

As you already know, we are currently working intensively on the next major update. We have already made some good progress for the update. 
However, because no one can work all the time, and because we are also affected by the summer, we have taken a break for a few days.
We hope you have some understanding for this.

The regular streams will start again on 4 July, and will then take place every Monday, Tuesday and Wednesday. 
The next update - which you are all waiting for - will come about a week after 4 July.

notes.title: News June
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

As some of you already know, we have paused the live streams for this week in order to work more intensively on the game as well as on important bugs, the multiplayer and the performance.

However, even though we have already made good progress in this regard, some of the functions we are currently working on still need to be expanded and, of course, tested very extensively before we can release them to you in a new update. 

For this reason, we unfortunately need more time, so that the live streams will also be paused for the time being until the next status update. 

As always, we will keep you informed as soon as we have news for you and therefore ask you for a little more patience.

We wish you a nice weekend!

notes.title: Update in progress
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

First of all, we know that you are all eagerly awaiting the first major update after Early Access, especially those of you who are used to our regular updates. That's why we wanted to let you know that we've been working hard on this major update since Early Access to fix the multiplayer, vehicle and voxel issues. 

However, in order to be able to bring you a stable update, it still needs one or two fixes and fine-tuning, so we will inform you as soon as we can say for sure that the update is ready. Until then, we would like to ask you for a little patience, even if it is difficult.

notes.title: Only 2 Days left
notes.content:
Only 2 more days, then the time has finally come. We have been waiting for this day for a long time:
On Friday, 13 May 2022 at 6 pm UTC, the game will be released on Steam in Early Access.

The next few days will be a challenge for us as well - all corners are still working hard on bugfixing for single and multiplayer for the release of version 0.6.
Because even though the game is still in development, we still want to give you a pleasant gaming experience.

On Friday, as almost every day, there will also be a livestream on Twitch and, as usual, it will start in the morning and run until around 2pm UTC. After that, we will be making the final internal preparations for the release.

Since this is a special day, we want to share that with you as well: There will be a live broadcast on the platform "Steam". This live broadcast is scheduled to start at 4pm UTC and can be viewed on the Gold Hunter shop page. We will be answering questions, doing giveaways and much more.

At 6 pm UTC we will release the game in Early Access as version 0.6 together with you and then accompany you through the evening. There will also be gameplay to watch.

We hope that you are looking forward to this day as much as we are and that you will spend the evening with us.

notes.title: Release
notes.content:
We have some news for you!

Finally we can give you a date for the Early Access on Steam:
Gold Hunter will be released on Steam on Friday, May 13th, 2022 at 6pm UTC.
At the same time we will stream the Early Access on Twitch - so you can be there live.

As you know, the playtest is currently running on Steam, which allows you to test the game for free.

The planned end of the playtest was originally May 1st 9.59pm UTC. 
However, due to the delays in reworking the multiplayer, we have decided to extend the playtest until May 6, 9.59pm UTC, so that you can still test it extensively.

We hope that with this announcement we can answer your open questions about the release.

notes.title: March News
notes.content:
You're probably already eagerly awaiting the next update, and well, we don't want to keep you waiting any longer.
The next update will be released on Steam on Monday at the latest. We are very excited about your feedback.

Next week we will work on other small updates that will fix bugs and other problems.
In addition, the multiplayer will be addressed so that it is also fully playable in a timely manner.

Furthermore we receive many requests if there is still the possibility to get a key to play the game.
Unfortunately, this will only be possible again in Early Access on Steam. But it's not that long until the release.
We want to increase the rush for the release and therefore there won't be another possibility to get a key before the release.

However, we have another good news for you: We will be opening up one or two playtests on Steam before the release.
When this will be and for how long, we don't want to reveal yet. Let us surprise you, but always keep an eye on the weekends.

That should be it for now. We wish you a nice weekend and stay healthy.

notes.title: January News
notes.content:
We wish all players a happy new year!

Also this time we have some news for you.

As some of you might have noticed, we were able to share some successes and goals with you last year. Among them is:
- We streamed over 1000 hours on Twitch, including over 210 hours in December alone.
- There were over 60 updates released last year - so on average there was an update/hotfix every 6 days.
- Meanwhile, we have over 3800 members on our Discord and our community continues to grow daily.
- Furthermore, our playtest officially launched on Steam at the end of December 2021, with currently more than 5700 participants.

These numbers are really impressive. But we still have a lot planned for this year, because Early Access is expected in the near future.

We have often been asked how long the playtest on Steam will run, and now we can finally give you a fixed date for it.
The official playtest on Steam will run up to and including 28.02.2022 at 23:59 (CET). 

But there are more news about the livestreams and the next update:
Our next update will be version 0.6 and thus will be very extensive. In this update we will work on further bug fixes, the gold distribution, the multiplayer syncronizations and much more. You can find more details on the roadmap. 

Of course, we are planning a bit more time for the big update, so the release of version 0.58 is scheduled for 04.02.2022.
This gives us enough time to extensively test functions, extend already existing functions or add new ones.

Finally, we have some not so nice news for all those who follow us regularly on our livestreams on Twitch, because the daily livestreams will be cancelled for the time being. 
But to keep you up to date, there will be only one livestream per week for the time being - and it will take place on Friday as usual. 
This way we can spend more time on the big update.

We wish you a nice rest of the week and see you on Friday in the livestream.

notes.title: Playtest
notes.content:
Don't forget: Tomorrow the game will be launched on Steam as "Playtest". Numerous players have already signed up and we would like to thank you for that.
This is already a great feedback for us, and the community is growing day by day.
The players who already have access to the game through their game library do not necessarily need to participate in the playtest.

The playtest will probably be available for 3 to 4 weeks. However, we will give advance notice before it ends.
The savegames will be the same for both versions and we will release regular updates for both versions. Furthermore there will also always be regular streams on Twitch.

Tomorrow there will also be a livestream on Twitch: We are working on the final preparations for the update and we will start the playtest during the evening.
We are looking forward to future feedback and wish you a happy new year.

[url=]https://www.twitch.tv/goldhuntermp[/url]

notes.title: Demo and Early Access
notes.content:
The year is coming to an end and many of you are already waiting for the announced Demo version. However, since at this point in time our own expectations for a demo have not yet been met, we have decided to give you a Playtest instead.

On 12/31/2021 we will therefore release a [b]Playtest[/b] version of GoldHunter on Steam. You can sign up for the [b]Playtest[/b] on Steam now, and as soon as it will be unlocked, you can download and test the game.
[u]This playtest is not yet a demo[/u], as it is offered with many games before the final release.
As you know, the game is still in development, and such a public playtest gives us as developers valuable feedback to improve the game on the way to the final release.

We also have another piece of news for you:
We will probably enter Early Access with GoldHunter on Steam in February or March next year.

Starting next Monday, the FindTheSecret event will be back on Discord and the daily development streams on Twitch.

notes.title: December News
notes.content:
We have some news for you.

As you might have noticed, we have released a lot of updates and hotfixes in the last weeks.
We also regularly respond to bug reports and suggestions from the community.
We would like to take this opportunity to thank you again for your feedback. This shows us how strong the community already is.
This allows us to find bugs faster and also to implement suggestions.

Meanwhile, the year is coming to an end and we are working hard on the upcoming release.
Among other things, this includes even more content and features in the game. For this reason we will not do a livestream for the next 2 weeks.
This is necessary from time to time, because we can't always show you everything in the stream. At the same time we will use the time to take a break in between.
Furthermore we make the last preparations for the upcoming release.

The planned update with version 0.573 on 12.12.2021 will therefore be cancelled and the next update will then be released on 19.12.2012.
On this day the next livestream will take place. You can follow the current status at any time on our roadmap.

Until then we wish you a relaxing time and stay healthy.

notes.title: News October
notes.content:
As you already know, we are working intensively on the next big update.
In our team, it's like in any other team: the weakest member sets the pace.
As you might have noticed from the livestream, I'm currently ill and unfortunately you can't plan something like that.

Unfortunately, there is no improvement in sight at the moment, so we are also thinking about how to proceed.
Since every member of the team plays an important role, and because there have already been disruptions as a result, there are also delays.
Unfortunately, we cannot yet tell you when everything will return to normal.

Therefore, for the time being, we can only say that the next major update will be delayed until further notice.
Regardless of this, we will still bring an update at the end of October, but it will only be a smaller update.
This update will at least give us the opportunity to fix small bugs and errors. Unfortunately, we will not be able to deliver the originally planned content with this update.
In addition, the subsequent content updates will also be postponed due to the delay.

We apologise for the inconvenience and hope for your understanding. 
Although we can plan and prepare a lot, there is not much we can do about a longer absence due to illness.
As soon as there is new information, we will inform you as soon as possible.
We also hope to be completely fit again soon and to be able to provide you with the new content.

notes.title: News June
notes.content:
We have some news for you again.

As you already know, we are working hard on version 0.6.

There are also preparations running in the background, which you didn't know about yet.

And now the time has come and we can tell you the news.

From version 0.6 there will be more functions and reworking.

This includes a overhaul of the map and the environment, as well as the sky, weather and the day and night cycle will be completely revised.

The playable map will be 18km² instead of 9km², so you can explore more.

Another change concerns the multiplayer. Until now it was possible to create a server via the main menu.

This will still be the case, but it was planned that dedicated server files will only be available through our official hoster for the first time.

We can now inform you that we will make the server files for dedicated servers available to every player.

It is planned to make the serverfiles available already for version 0.6. (Changes are still possible).

The server needs of course a appropriate equipment, we will inform you of the recommended requirements. 

These were now the most important changes for version 0.6 - and unfortunately this also has disadvantages.

Unfortunately, we have to postpone the release of 0.6, as this version includes the revision of the map, the creation and optimization of the server files and a few other features. 

Currently the team is also not at full strength, which is unfortunately another reason for the delay.

Due to these changes and incidents, we have decided to postpone the release of version 0.6 to December 2021.

This doesn't sound nice at first, but with the news already mentioned, you as a player have a lot more possibilities to experience the game.

That's why we don't want to rush this and use the time to make the game experience even more attractive for you.

Furthermore, we will publish short videos in the future, which will show excerpts of version 0.6.

Here is a summary of all news.

■ new map (18km²)
■ revision of the sky, weather, day and night rhythm
■ public server files
■ release of version 0.6 in December 2021

That should be it for now. This news was also announced earlier today in the livestream on Twitch.

We wish you a good start into the weekend and stay healthy.

notes.title: News about the public demo
notes.content:
Unfortunately we have to inform you that we have to postpone the release of the demo indefinitely.
The update on 29.01. will take place anyway, but only for the current players who also own the game.

The reasons for this are quickly explained. Since the headquarters of our development studio is located in Germany, we have to comply with the local legal requirements.

The authority "Federal Review Board for Media Harmful to Minors" is responsible for the rating of the game.
It is clear from the guidelines that we are not allowed to publish the game until our game has received a classification.
This also includes the public demo. After several discussions with our lawyer and the authorities, it was decided that the public demo must be postponed.
Unfortunately we can't give a new date at the moment, because we don't know how long the processing of our request for evaluation will take.

The game can still be purchased, but it must not be available to the entire market.
This includes public demos and any other release that allows any player to use the game.
The authority "Federal Review Board for Media Harmful to Minors" is also aware that the development of a game is financed by donations, support and possibly rewards, such as access to the game, merch, etc. 
This is tolerated by the authorities and does not fall under the rating.

Of course we could publish the game before, but the risk is too big for us and we don't want to spend the money for fines and/or penalties.

We also know that this is not the news you expected or wished for, but we all want the game to be a success and we have to abide by the law.

If you have any questions, feel free to contact us and if you want, we can discuss it in a livestream on Twitch.

Otherwise we wish you a nice weekend. If there is any new information, we will let you know.

notes.title: Release Information
notes.content:
Soon it is time, only a short time left until the first demo release.
Many hours, sleepless nights and a lot of energy were invested to make this possible. 
And especially in the last days we have worked hard to get ready in time for the demo release.

Apparently one of our plugins was updated in one of the last updates and now causes a problem.
The whole thing affects multiplayer and causes that not every player can get on the server and cannot be created as a character. Unfortunately, this was discovered too late by us, and therefore we are now in this situation. Our highest priority is that we do not provide you with a half-finished demo, but that both the single and the whole game are available for download. Especially that the multiplayer mode works, which you are eagerly waiting for.

We've been working on the problem for a few days now and have had many team meetings, but it hasn't led to the desired result. We know, this news comes unfortunately very late, but we wanted to keep the release day on Friday. We also didn't want to offer you garbage as a demo. We want you to have the possibility to get to know the game properly and not permanently annoyed because something doesn't work. Currently we can tell you that we need a few more days to solve the problem and give you the desired gaming fun. 

We are already busy with troubleshooting and will inform you as soon as we have new news and can publish the demo. We can understand your disappointment and your displeasure very well, because we feel the same way because we couldn't keep the deadline. We were also looking forward to sharing the demo with you tomorrow and your feedback on it.

But we won't give up right now, and to make active use of the time, we will also cancel the stream this Friday, because we really need every spare minute to solve the problem and to make the game fun for you in a demo that we would also like to see for ourselves.

notes.title: Latest News
notes.content:
On the current situation with Corona we also have to realize that we are affected too.
Unfortunately, this is not only a local problem, it's a global problem.

It was originally planned to release the project on 1st of May 2020 on Kickstarter.
Unfortunately this will not be possible in a meaningful way and we had to find an alternative.
Kickstarter has also written an article about the fact, that in the current situation it will 
be difficult to successfully fund a project and one should look for alternatives.
Here is the link to the article : https://www.kickstarter.com/articles/creative-projects-community-COVID-19

We then had several team meetings and also asked the community about it.

The team has now agreed that we should create our own campaign on our homepage.
This has many advantages as we don't have to pay any fees, have no time limit and we 
can create our own decide how we want to build the campaign.

Additional time must be invested in the creation of the campaign, including updating and enhancing the homepage. This means the descriptions, details, rewards and payment systems that we provide in order 
to guarantee a smooth process.

Based on these changes, it is simply not possible to keep to the release on 1st of May 2020.
We have decided to postpone the whole thing. There will be the following changes.

■ Livestreams on Saturday will be cancelled (Friday there will still be a stream)
■ Release for the streaming partners, 1st supporter, 2nd supporter and own 
campaign are set on the same date
■ 2nd supporters are limited, at the latest at the start of the campaign they are no longer available

■ Release for the campaign is set for 22th of May 2020
■ Streaming Partner, 1st Supporter, 2nd Supporter have access to the demo from 22th of May 2020
■ public demo will continue to be released at some point, but it has not yet been decided whether it will be available via the homepage or Steam

We are also in discussion with one or the other investors, perhaps this will open up other possibilities.
If you still have ideas for the campaign, you are welcome to write them down in our Discord.

The livestreams on Friday will be available in the future, we will show news, updates and answer your questions. Unfortunately we had to make these changes to reduce the current or future problems.
We think that everyone can understand it. Even if the demo is only meant to 
give a first impression of the game start, we don't want to sacrifice quality.

One more thing at the end. In this situation we can grow even more together.
And very important: Stay at home and stay healthy.
